prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: landscape essay cover for a restrained personal blog, approximately 1.9:1 aspect ratio.
Primary request: a sophisticated abstract editorial illustration of the assignment-problem paradox: the more capable person is used to support an organization's invisible maintenance, while a smaller capability receives the visible strategic position.
Scene/backdrop: uninterrupted warm ivory paper (#F4F1EA).
Subject: one simple thin horizontal platform held up at its underside by a large muted slate-blue geometric pillar; a small dusty-clay rounded upright piece stands visibly on the top of that platform, off-center above the larger hidden support. The lower pillar is much larger than the small upright piece, visibly carrying the structure's load yet denied the open space above. A gentle translucent ivory spotlight triangle touches only the small piece on top; its edges are extremely faint. Make this read as a subtle editorial metaphor for unequal visibility, with no literal human faces or equipment.
Style/medium: restrained flat cut-paper silhouettes, subtly imperfect organic edges, extremely subtle print grain, fine charcoal accents.
Composition/framing: wide horizontal canvas, compact central composition, abundant empty ivory space, key forms in central 60 percent; reveal both upper visible position and lower support clearly. Use just 4 primary forms: broad platform, large pillar below, small rounded upright above, faint light shape.
Lighting/mood: quiet, critical, reflective; soft and understated, no dramatic theatrical glow.
Color palette: ivory #F4F1EA; muted slate-blue #778B99 for the strong support; dusty clay #C9A18F for small visible upright; a fine charcoal #414846 platform line.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, formulas, graphs, labels, logos, watermark, border, title, gears, decorative symbols, busy office details, glossy 3D, photographic realism or saturated colors. Do not show a blocked staircase, crowns, winner trophies, or corporate clip art. Produce the illustration only.
alt_en: A large support carries the platform while a smaller form receives the spotlight.
alt_ko: 큰 받침이 무대를 떠받치는 동안 작은 형태만 조명을 받는 모습으로 역할 배치의 역설을 표현한다.
concept: Both editions explain how the strongest employee becomes the maintenance stabilizer while a less capable colleague receives strategic visibility. A larger hidden support and a smaller lit form visualize role allocation rather than talent.

inspection.notes: Viewed generated asset at full resolution; restrained palette, no embedded text, central metaphor legible and landscape aspect ratio suitable for the blog.
